$description: Motion — code-only (Figma variables have no easing type). Durations from the Tailwind / Polaris ms scale; easing curves follow Material 3 (standard) and the Tailwind/CSS decelerate-accelerate pair, named by role.

100.$description: Colour / border changes on hover and focus.

150.$description: Small controls switching state (checkbox, toggle). Small surfaces leaving.

300.$description: Things that travel or grow (progress fill, panels).

standard.$description: Material 3 standard — for something that stays on screen and changes (state, size, position).

enter.$description: Decelerate — for something appearing; it arrives fast and settles.

exit.$description: Accelerate — for something leaving; it starts slow and goes.

linear.$description: Constant speed — loops such as a spinner.
